messages.author: 578e4484fb57a2d5
messages.subject: formmarkerCovar error when running MQM
parts:
Hello,

I am performing MQM on a dataset of 133 RILs with 1190 markers.

I am attempting to use the command "formMarkerCovar" on a dataset I created using sim.geno (g00lg_third_sim).

Below is the command I am running with the error. If anyone knows the cause of this error, it would be much appreciated.

> covar8 <- formMarkerCovar(g00lg_third.sim, markers=c( 101,630,694 ), method="imp")

Error in `colnames<-`(`*tmp*`, value = c("1", "0")) :
length of 'dimnames' [2] not equal to array extent
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In matchchr(chr, names(x$geno)) : Chr NA not found
2: In formMarkerCovar(g00lg_third.sim, markers = c(101, 630, 694), :
Some markers not found: 101 630 694

Thank you very much,

Ben Stewart-Brown

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] formmarkerCovar error when running MQM
parts:
The 'markers' argument needs to be either a vector of marker names or a vector of character strings like "5...@25.0".

And clearly I need to do a better job of trapping errors and giving informative error messages.

karl
